description:
**Surfaced 2026-05-16 by CATO Arc 27 review (P2-3).** Arc 27 added new substrate/templates/handoff-doc-template.md with YAML frontmatter `author: Denson Smith` per directive A7 + CLAUDE.md authorship discipline. The other six existing templates in substrate/templates/ have NO YAML frontmatter:

- paste-instruction-template.md
- onboarding-questions.md
- consent-prompts.md
- polling-cron-prompt-template.md
- activation-paste-cheatsheet.md
- autonomous-mode-activation-template.md

To align with the new convention (and the broader CLAUDE.md authorship discipline that requires every author-like field to say Denson Smith), each existing template should gain the same frontmatter. Trivial diff: prepend three lines to each file. No semantic change to template body or its slots. Forward-only adoption is fine; this just makes the convention consistent across the templates dir before a future reader notices the inconsistency.

**Scope:** add YAML frontmatter `---\n author: Denson Smith\n ---` to the top of the six listed templates. Verify the Stoa app's gen-data Zod schema still validates (project CLAUDE.md notes substrate frontmatter changes need to keep the adapter valid; the templates dir likely isn't in the adapter's read scope but verify).

**Empirical anchor:** Arc 27 commit 85f0b4d (added new template with frontmatter); CATO verdict round 1 finding P2-3 surfaced the inconsistency.
title: Apply author: Denson Smith frontmatter to existing 6 substrate templates
